title: Limited evaluation on diverse tasks
description: The Transformer is evaluated only on machine translation (two language pairs) and English constituency parsing. The authors state they plan to apply the model to other tasks in future work, acknowledging the limited task scope.
canonical_description: model evaluated on a limited set of tasks beyond translation and parsing

evidence.anchor: plan to apply them to other tasks
evidence.quote: We are excited about the future of attention-based models and plan to apply them to other tasks.

evidence.anchor: performed only a small number of experiments to select
evidence.quote: We performed only a small number of experiments to select the dropout, both attention and residual (section~[REF:sec:reg]), learning rates and beam size on the Section 22 development set, all other parameters remained unchanged from the English-to-German base translation model.

title: Extension to non-text modalities
description: The Transformer is only applied to text input and output. The authors explicitly plan to extend the model to problems involving other modalities such as images, audio, and video.
canonical_description: model only applied to text modality, needs extension to other modalities

evidence.anchor: problems involving input and output modalities other than text
evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.

title: Local restricted attention for long sequences
description: Full self-attention computes over all positions, which is computationally expensive for very long sequences. The authors propose restricting attention to a local neighborhood and state this as future work.
canonical_description: full self-attention expensive for long sequences, needs restricted local attention

evidence.anchor: We plan to investigate this approach further in future work
evidence.quote: We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.

title: Non-autoregressive generation
description: The Transformer generates output tokens sequentially in an autoregressive manner. The authors state that making generation less sequential is a research goal for future work.
canonical_description: autoregressive generation limits parallelism, non-autoregressive decoding needed

evidence.anchor: Making generation less sequential is another research goals
evidence.quote: Making generation less sequential is another research goals of ours.

title: Untested extrapolation of sinusoidal positional encodings
description: The sinusoidal positional encoding is chosen because it may allow extrapolation to sequence lengths longer than those seen during training, but this capability is hypothesized and not empirically tested in the paper.
canonical_description: extrapolation of sinusoidal positional encodings to unseen sequence lengths is hypothesized but untested

evidence.anchor: it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training
evidence.quote: We chose the sinusoidal version because it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training.

evidence.anchor: we hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions
evidence.quote: We chose this function because we hypothesized it would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, since for any fixed offset $k$, $PE_{pos+k}$ can be represented as a linear function of $PE_{pos}$.

title: Independence assumption for query and key components
description: To motivate the scaling factor in dot-product attention, the authors assume the components of queries and keys are independent random variables with mean 0 and variance 1, which is a simplifying assumption about the learned representations.
canonical_description: query and key components assumed independent with zero mean and unit variance to justify attention scaling

evidence.anchor: assume that the components of $q$ and $k$ are independent random variables with mean $0$ and variance $1$
evidence.quote: We suspect that for large values of $d_k$, the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax function into regions where it has extremely small gradients  \footnote{To illustrate why the dot products get large, assume that the components of $q$ and $k$ are independent random variables with mean $0$ and variance $1$.

title: Reduced effective resolution from averaging attention weights
description: Self-attention averages attention-weighted positions, which reduces effective resolution. The paper acknowledges this as a cost of using attention and counteracts it with multi-head attention.
canonical_description: attention averaging reduces effective resolution of representations

evidence.anchor: cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section~[REF:sec:attention].

title: Need for more sophisticated compatibility function
description: Reducing attention key size hurts model quality, which the authors interpret as evidence that determining compatibility is not easy and that a more sophisticated compatibility function than dot-product may be beneficial.
canonical_description: dot-product compatibility function may be insufficient, more sophisticated function needed

evidence.anchor: a more sophisticated compatibility function than dot product may be beneficial
evidence.quote: This suggests that determining compatibility is not easy and that a more sophisticated compatibility function than dot product may be beneficial.
